fn main() {
    let abcs = vec("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "i", "j", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "p", "q", "r", "s", "t", "u", "v", "w", "x", "y", "z", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9", "0")
    let text = abcs.join("")
    let numbers: Vec<Int> = text.chars().map(parse_int).filter(is_some).map(unwrap).collect()
    let sum = numbers.iter().fold(0, add)
    print(sum)
}

fn is_some(x: &Option<Int>) -> Bool {
    match x {
        Some(_) => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn unwrap(x: &Option<Int>) -> Int {
    match x {
        Some(a) => a,
        _ => -1,
    }
}

fn add(x: Int, y: Int) -> Int {
    x + y
}

fn parse_int(s: &Str) -> Option<Int> {
    if s == "" {
        return None
    }
    let first = char_at(s, 0)
    if first == "-" || first == "+" {
        let tail = substring(s, 1, len(s) - 1)
        parse_int(&tail).map(mul(if first == "-" { -1 } else { 1 }))
    } else if first >= "0" && first <= "9" {
        let mut n = 0
        for c in chars(s) {
            let digit = ord(c) - ord("0")
            if digit < 0 || digit > 9 {
                return None
            }
            n = n * 10 + digit
        }
        Some(n)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn char_at(s: &Str, n: Int) -> Str {
    let cs = chars(s)
    let mut i = 0
    while i < n {
        cs.next()
        i = i + 1
    }
    cs.next().unwrap_or("")
}

fn substring(s: &Str, start: Int, end: Int) -> Str {
    let cs = chars(s)
    let mut i = 0
    let mut buf = ""
    while i < start {
        buf = buf + cs.next().unwrap_or("")
        i = i + 1
    }
    while i <= end {
        buf = buf + cs.next().unwrap_or("")
        i = i + 1
    }
    buf
}

fn mul(x: Int, y: Int) -> Int {
    x * y
}

fn ord(c: &Str) -> Int {
    c.as_bytes().get(0).unwrap_or(&b).to_int()
}

fn len(s: &Str) -> Int {
    chars(s).count()
}

fn print(x: Int) {
    print_str(str_from_int(x))
}

fn print_str(s: &Str) {
    native_print(s)
}

fn native_print(s: &Str) {
    print(s)
}
